items.headline: Highlight: No. 10 Texas A&M bests Arizona State as defense scores twice in fourth
items.description: The Aggies pull away late in the fourth quarter as Marco Jones' fumble recovery for a 55-yard touchdown and Julio Humphrey's pick-six fuels the 48-20 win over the Sun Devils.

items.headline: No. 10 Texas A&M beats Arizona State 48-20 as defense scores twice in fourth
items.description: — Marcel Reed had three touchdown passes and the defense scored twice in the fourth quarter as No. 10 Texas A&M pulled away late for a 48-20 victory over Arizona State on Saturday.

items.headline: Elko highlights Reed's growth, previews matchup vs. Arizona State
items.description: Mike Elko discusses how he is preparing to attack Kenny Dillingham's offense while saying Marcel Reed is growing as a player and a leader.

items.headline: Hart details how No. 8 Texas A&M can chase national title behind Reed
items.description: EPSN's Tom Hart joins The Paul Finebaum Show to discuss what a win for the Aggies against the Sun Devils will mean for postseason positioning and how Marcel Reed can evolve his game.

items.description: Bluebloods have a chance at the early-season's biggest win. Big 12 and SEC have early conference challenges, and the G6 has an elimination weekend.
